title: Pluto Meaning
overview: and houses Pluto, the transformative catalyst and ruler of the underworld, guides us through profound change, rebirth, and spiritual awakening. As the modern ruler of Scorpio and co-ruler with Mars in Aries, Pluto symbolizes spiritual evolution, karma, and transformative cycles. Pluto makes us look more deeply into any house it is transiting. Pluto is the modern planetary ruler of Scorpio and co-rules with Mars in Aries. Pluto symbolizes the process o spiritual evolution, the cycles of karma, Judgement, and rebirth that we experience throughout our lives. Pluto serves as a guiding force in facing our past actions, making amends, and embracing a higher level of consciousness. Moreover, Pluto's domain encompasses themes of personal power, transformation, and the unearthing o hidden truths. It governs the exploration of the depths of our psyche, unveiling the shadow aspects of our being, and facilitating profound spiritual growth. In the Tarot, Pluto corresponds with the Judgement, the twentieth card in the Major Arcana. Like Pluto, Judgement symbolizes a moment of introspection and self-evaluation, urging us to make amends and align our lives with higher principles. From a numerological perspective, the number twenty associated with the Judgement card signies the culmination of a cycle and the emergence of a higher level of consciousness. Pluto spends a considerable amount of time in each zodiac sign, ranging from about twelve to thirty years, due to its elliptical orbit. Pluto's transition from one zodiac sign to another, taking place approximately every 12 to 30 years on average, is believed to symbolize the transformative shis and advancements that shape an entire generation.
